digest.component_or_area: mutation testing gate and CI workflow
propositions: Mutation shard enforcement modes (advisory, ratchet, strict) are selected per-shard from a manifest with explicit timeout configuration and promotion criteria.

Advisory mode runs head-only evidence gathering; ratchet mode compares fresh base/head archives and preserves unchanged legacy survivors; strict mode requires all mutants to be killed or individually fingerprinted as equivalent.

Shard promotion proceeds through evidence phases: initial advisory gathering, then ratchet after three stable pilot runs under 24 minutes, then strict only after legacy non-killed outcomes are remediated or reviewed.
Changed source, test, support, or global-mutation inputs are detected and mapped to corresponding shards; unmatched Python tests are reported as advisory findings.
Selector generates JSON for per-shard matrix jobs with independent 30-minute caps, exact Gerrit patchset checkout, vote.needs inclusion, and always-published structured evidence and artifacts.

Repository mutation configuration lives only in .github/mutation-shards.toml; pinned mutmut 3.7.0 with timeout_constant=1.0 and timeout_multiplier=15.0 is synthesized into each archive config, and no duplicate global mutmut mapping remains.
